options.reason: Annual counts directly answer how many pedestrians were killed each year and make year-to-year differences easy to compare.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the question directly by summing pedestrian deaths over crashes in each calendar year. The bar chart shows the annual totals, with a high of 176 in 2013 and a low of 101 in 2020; raw counts are appropriate because the question asks how many. It does not show pedestrian deaths per population, per trip, or per crash.
